rows.what_the_ink_shows: The right-hand margin plainly reads λ_ν² = 2ξ_{2ν} = ξ^{2ν}: each equals sign has two separate horizontal strokes, the coefficient 2 is unprefixed, and there is no minus, ±, or (−1)^ν factor at either equality (crops/56_scan026_L194_L903_lambda_square.png). The surrounding bracketed rules contain degree qualifications, including the zero products, but no restriction that ν be even and no correction to the square formula (crops/56_scan026_L194_L903_margin_context.png). The lower diagram conditions are ‘si i < j = 2ν’ and ‘si i = 2ν < j’ (crops/56_scan026_L194_L903_restriction_condition.png and crops/56_scan026_L194_L903_pushforward_condition.png); they are attached to the indicated maps and do not supply a ν-parity condition for the square. The supplied TeX records the positive formula exactly.
rows.note: Preserve the literal positive equality λ_ν² = 2ξ_{2ν} = ξ^{2ν}. The supplied mathematical correction is λ_ν² = (−1)^ν ξ^{2ν}, giving a positive sign for ν even and a negative sign for ν odd. L194 motivates this using λ = α − β and the ν=1 example; the cited Pro note was not consulted. L194 and L903 are duplicate proposals at the same physical locus and share the crops. Both decisions are b against the original, not c because of the overlap. The parity factor is a supplied mathematical correction, not omitted transcription of visible ink.

check_event.type: used and rechecked in this run
check_event.outcome: Viewed the full assigned scan and four enlarged contrast-raised crops of the square formula, its margin context, and the two displayed map conditions. Confirmed the uncancelled positive formula and absence of a ν-parity qualifier at that locus. Classified this row b independently against the supplied original and retained all text and diagrams. No OCR, other-page consultation, or mathematical proof checking was used.
